questions.question: Which statements are sound? Select all that apply.

answers.text: A personal work email gives Pro the organisation's Team controls.
answers.feedback: A work email does not turn a personal Pro subscription into a Team workspace.

answers.text: Paid plans can still have usage limits.
answers.feedback: Correct. More usage is not unlimited usage.

answers.text: Team needs at least two members.
answers.feedback: Correct. The official Team guide specifies at least two members.

answers.text: Use invented information for the course exercises.
answers.feedback: Correct. Invented examples avoid using real private information.

answers.text: Ask the manager to approve the upload without checking policy.
